To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the different lactobaccilli isolates from fermented batter exhibited potent probiotic and immune modulatory properties.
the isolates exhibited probiotic and immunoregulatory activities and could have application as a probiotic in fermented foods and as immunomodulators.

the probiotic properties of the lactobacilli strains isolated from uttapam, a popular fermented food in South India, were enhanced by Piper betel L. leaves and the selected strains may have applications in the development of probiotic fermented food products.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the screening of potential probiotic strains from fermented batter supplementing with P. betle L. for their probiotic and immunological properties and their possible applications in fermented foods.
the selection of potent probiotics from fermented food supplementing with Piper Betle L. leaves.
the screening and selection of probiotic strains for use in food products, and also in the prevention and treatment of diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AJ7 and AJ8 were selected as potent probiotic and AJ82 had the best immunomodulatory activity among the isolates.

the isolates have the ability to inhibit pathogenic bacteria, adhere to intestinal epithelial cells and reduce pro-inflammatory cytokines, which may help in the prevention of gastrointestinal infections.
the isolates AJ7 and AJ 82 are the most promising probiotics for the use in food industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the selected isolates AJ7 and AJ8 may have applications in the development of fermented foods as well as immunomodulators.
the isolates exhibited properties that are important for probiotics and immunomodulation.
the isolates exhibited properties which could make them potential probiotic candidates and may be used in the development of novel probiotic products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
probiotic screening of Lactobaciilli isolates is important in order to identify potent strains for probiotic use and to avoid the use of strains that are not beneficial to the host.
probiotic lactobacilli from fermented batter supplementing with Piper Betle L. leaves may be useful in the prevention of gastrointestinal and vaginal infections.
the use of probiotic bacteria in fermented foods is an effective strategy for improving the health of consumers and for reducing the incidence of gastrointestinal diseases.
